## Summary
- On the showroom slide, the mileage (and other long spec values) could wrap onto a second line under the icon instead of staying beside it (reported: "op showroomslides wrapt dit niet zo mooi").
- Root cause: `i { width: 60px }` has no effect on an inline `<i>`, so the three icons never actually got a uniform reserved width, and the spec value sat as plain inline text next to it with no `nowrap`, so a fixed 50px font in a narrower column would break the value onto a new line (sometimes mid-number).
- Fix: each spec row (`ownstock/showroom_vehicle.blade.php`) is now a flex row — a fixed-width icon box plus a `.spec-value` span with `white-space: nowrap`, `overflow: hidden` and `text-overflow: ellipsis`, and `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so the three rows line up. Size and typography of the slide are unchanged; a value that still doesn't fit even on the full 1920×1080 download size (e.g. a long hybrid fuel name) now truncates with "…" instead of wrapping or running off the slide.
- Finding logged (opgelost) against R S2-7.14: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-showroom-slide-specs-wrappen.md`.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter="Showroom|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring"` — 38 tests, 823 assertions, green.
- [x] Screenshots before/after at the download size (1920×1080) and at 1440px (where the wrap was most visible), with a vehicle at 60,252 km and fuel type "Elektrisch/Benzine hybride".

params.title: The showroom slide keeps each spec on one line
